description: This file declares functions and constants for managing radio traffic harvesting and scanning intervals, including setting and getting harvesting status, reporting and polling periods, default values, and override time-to-live (TTL).

methods.name: SetRISHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for radio traffic scans, returning 0 on success and 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetRISHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status, true if enabled, false if disabled.

methods.name: SetRISReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period for radio traffic scan in seconds.

methods.name: GetRISReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current radio traffic reporting period.

methods.name: SetRISPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period for radio traffic scan in seconds.

methods.name: GetRISPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current radio traffic polling period.

methods.name: SetRISReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period for radio traffic scan.

methods.name: GetRISReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default radio traffic reporting period.

methods.name: SetRISPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period for radio traffic scan.

methods.name: GetRISPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default radio traffic polling period.

methods.name: GetRISOverrideTTL
methods.description: Gets the timeout after which RIS intervals revert to default values, in seconds.

methods.name: SetRISOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the timeout for RIS scans to trigger accelerated polling, in seconds.

methods.name: GetRISOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default timeout for accelerated scans.

methods.name: ValidateRISPeriod
methods.description: Validates that a given period value is within the acceptable range.
